info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Favorites-v1-spec
info.description: The List Favorite Pets API allows users to retrieve a curated list of pets marked as favorites within the pet adoption platform. By utilizing this endpoint, consumers can easily access the details of their favorite pets, making it seamless to revisit or consider potential adoptions. This API is particularly useful for pet adopters who want to track and manage their preferred selections. Developers can integrate this functionality into their applications, enhancing the user experience by providing quick access to favorite pets.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of favorite pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch their favorite pets from the database. It returns a list of pets that have been marked as favorites by the user, providing relevant details and characteristics of each pet.
